messages:
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@catalyst-consult.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12 -0800
Subject: Rapid Integrator Lab Kit — week-of Jan 10 proposed / logistics

Hi Alex / Catalyst team,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Based on our roadmap discussion I put together a compact hands-on "Rapid Integrator Lab Kit" designed to get your consultants productive on Redwood’s runtime and observability stack in a 3-day in-person lab + 1 day of follow-ups. High-level goals:

- Hands-on model deployment and troubleshooting routines
- Runbook-driven integrations to customers' CI/CD pipelines
- Training for your implementation consultants (certification-ready)
- Shared MAP for customer pilot kickoff

Proposed week: Jan 10–13 (we aim for the lab Mon–Wed, remote wrap Thu). Before we lock dates I need a few logistics items from you:

1) Confirm headcount (number of Catalyst consultants attending).
2) AV / room requirements and any travel constraints.
3) Any internal sample datasets you want to keep inside the Catalyst sandbox (PII/no-PII).

Attachments: lab-agenda.pdf (draft), sandbox-access-instructions.txt (how we provision the sandbox image).

If Jan 10 doesn’t work, propose alternatives — otherwise I’ll book rooms and send invites by EOD tomorrow.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@catalyst-consult.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid Integrator Lab Kit — week-of Jan 10 proposed / logistics

Hi Dylan — thanks for the plan, this looks useful. Samir and I will lead the engagement from Catalyst. Quick answers:

- Headcount: likely 4 consultants on site (two senior integrators, two implementation engineers).
- AV: standard AV plus one HDMI laptop hookup and a whiteboard; we may bring a small router for the hands-on sandbox to avoid corporate firewall issues.
- Datasets: we can provide synthetic logs + a small anonymized customer prompt corpus; we will not provide PII.

Couple questions:
- Can Redwood provide a sandbox VM image we can run locally if venue networking is flaky?
- Do you have a short pre-read for our consultants so they can come with the right environment set up?

We’re good to tentatively lock Jan 10. I’ll confirm travel by Friday.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Director, Solutions Consulting — Catalyst Consulting

From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@catalyst-consult.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Rapid Integrator Lab Kit — week-of Jan 10 proposed / logistics

Alex — great, thanks. Answers below and next steps.

1) Sandbox image: yes — we can provide a pre-built image (rwinf-sandbox-2026-11.qcow2) that contains our serving runtime, sample models, and a tiny dataset so you can run locally if network is flaky. I attached the filename in the attachments list; we'll share a secure download link once we finalize attendees.

2) Pre-read / environment checklist: see Drive link (below). It’s a 20–30 minute checklist that covers laptop prerequisites, SSH key exchange, and local Docker/VM requirements. Recommend consultants run the pre-check 48h before the lab.

Proposed draft agenda (attached in lab-agenda.pdf) — day 1: runtime internals + model deployment; day 2: observability/troubleshooting & customer playbook; day 3: integration patterns + hands-on customer scenario; day 4: remote follow-up + certification exam window.

Logistics: I’ll book the rooms for Jan 10–12 assuming no objections. Stephanie (cc’d) will own the training artifacts & the cert blueprint. Marissa and Priyom — please review MAP template and suggested success metrics below.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-RapidIntegratorLab
HubSpot: HS-Contact-823412-RDW (I created a record for the engagement).

Thanks — I’ll send calendar invites once Alex confirms travel.

—Dylan

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks Dylan — copying my notes and a few requests for Catalyst before we proceed. Quoting your note for context:

> Proposed draft agenda (attached in lab-agenda.pdf) — day 1: runtime internals + model deployment; day 2: observability/troubleshooting & customer playbook; day 3: integration patterns + hands-on customer scenario; day 4: remote follow-up + certification exam window.

Additions / requests:
- Certification blueprint (cert-blueprint.md) — I’ve drafted the knowledge-check outline and the practical lab exercise rubric. We want Catalyst consultants to be eligible for "Redwood Integrator Associate (RIA)" certification after completing the lab and passing the practical.
- Success metrics (90day-success.kpi) — propose we track: pilot readiness (deployable model in customer environment), mean time to recovery on failure scenarios, and handoff completeness (runbook + MAP signed).
- Compliance ask: please confirm if Catalyst can sign our partner NDA and provide SOC2 Type II attestations and any relevant penetration-test summaries for their consultancy tooling (we need this for enterprise customers).
- Rooms/AV: if Catalyst brings a local router, please share IP ranges so we can pre-open firewall rules on our sandbox subnet.

Attachments: cert-blueprint.md, 90day-success.kpi (attached here for review).

If Catalyst confirms SOC2 + NDA by next Thursday, we can proceed to book travel and finalize the MAP.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
